claim: When something overwrites a figure while it is drawn, the original's later XOR erase leaves ghost pixels that the converted game does not; differences confined to the undo buffer are fine if nothing reads it.

evidence.text: 4 undo-buffer-only differences in 33,294 pixel tests (the original's ghost pixels; nothing else reads that buffer); a later run lists 5 of 101,594 differing.
5 of 171,382 pixel tests failed: an object drawn over Dizzy then his eraser's XOR leaves a hole or ghost the build does not have.
